lines.text: Lines one hundred eighty-five to ninety-four do the same for turning.
Braking angle: the angle left, minus spin rate times heading reaction time. No spin yet, so one point five seven radians.
Then three spin rates; the smallest wins. Max omega: six.
Can I still stop turning: the square root of twelve times one point five seven. Four point three four.
The gentle line: five times one point five seven, seven point eight five.
Smallest: four point three four, the number from the board.
Lines one hundred ninety-three and ninety-four: inside the deadband, zero. Otherwise copy sign gives it the error's sign.
So plus four point three four radians per second: counterclockwise, toward ninety degrees.
This loop's wish: four meters per second forward, four point three four radians per second of spin.
